errors.description: The model failed to recognize that the sequence between the first and second pause is Sequence 2 (7, 183, 94, 177, 192) and instead selected a fragmented and incorrect subset of numbers from later sequences. It omitted 183 and 94, and included 195 and 112 (from Sequence 3) and 87 (from Sequence 4), indicating a complete breakdown in tracking the correct temporal boundaries of sequences.

Even within its incorrect selection of numbers, the model miscalculated the sum. The correct sum of 7 + 177 + 195 + 112 is 591, not 391. This arithmetic error compounds the earlier logical failures, but is secondary to the fundamental misidentification of the target sequence.
